input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: creative track: For Other Minds story from the BIBLE.md Next up proposal 'The ones who live past the bridge' (instrumental variables)

errors.what: First model draft gave attenders a lower naive admission rate (the wrong sign for the proposal); then a version with selection only on recorded frailty made covariate-adjusted OLS unbiased, which would have made the instrument pointless. Fixed by adding an unrecorded severity term; both caught before drafting.

doc_friction.issue: Says 'pick the project that has gone longest without a new piece' from git log; platform/ci/creative_due.py (named only in the venture README) does this properly and should be the first step the prompt names.
numpy was not on the bare python3; pyenv.py installs it, but a pure-Python model (as the story notes prefer, 'Python's random module') needed no numpy, so the install was wasted time.

deviations.why: Audio cap exceeded (577 MB of 400 MB), so no audio rendered, per the prompt's own rule.
deviations.result: node --test passes; llms.txt lists the story as audio to follow

deviations.why: The proposal suggested distance as the instrument; the story uses the binary side of the river (a distance-induced instrument) because a one-bridge catchment makes the step clean and readable for the shelf.
deviations.did: binary instrument with covariate-adjusted 2SLS and a pre-period check
deviations.result: estimate near the model's true value; interval honest

notes: Project: hearth-and-horizon, shelf for-other-minds (drawn by creative_due.py). Piece: the-ones-who-live-past-the-bridge (about 3,000 words + note), text only. Model in the story note: seed 2055, true effect 9 per 100; naive +8.4, adjusted OLS -0.9, Wald -16.5, 2SLS -7.3 (-19.7 to +5.2); 200-seed mean -8.0 (sd 7.2). Weekdays checked with datetime. New Next up proposal: 'The forty cuts' (forking paths); three subjects.txt candidates. Checks run here: node --test in ventures/hearth-and-horizon (20 pass), run_venture_tests.py hearth-and-horizon ok, check_posts.py ok. No agent doc: nothing a next run needs beyond the bible and the story note.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a writer with statistics training drafting a 3,000-word story and building and checking a simulated IV model

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
